hero.headline: Help Starts Here
hero.subtext: Nasna connects displaced individuals with government and NGO aid across Lebanon. Register once and get matched with the support you need.

steps.title: How It Works
steps.subtitle: Three simple steps to access the aid you need.

step1.title: Fill the Form
step1.desc: Share your household details, location, and immediate needs in a few minutes.

step2.title: Review & Verify
step2.desc: Your information is reviewed by our partner organizations.

step3.title: Receive Aid
step3.desc: Get matched with food, shelter, medical care, and other essential services.

secure.title: Secure & Private
secure.desc: Your data is encrypted and shared only with verified partner organizations.

free.title: Completely Free
free.desc: No fees, no catches. Nasna is a free platform for those in need.

trusted.title: Trusted Partners
trusted.desc: We work with government bodies and accredited NGOs across Lebanon.

cta.title: Ready to Register?
cta.subtitle: The form takes less than 5 minutes. Your information helps us get you the right support faster.
